summary: This Form 6-K is a routine earnings announcement press release by CMB.TECH NV, a foreign private issuer, stating that it will release first quarter 2026 results on May 19, 2026 and host a conference call. There are no special-situation elements: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing merely schedules an ordinary quarterly earnings release and analyst call. As a non-US filing under Form 6-K, it is the equivalent of a routine earnings press release under US rules. No deal terms are present.
